Growth SBI Children's Fund Savings Plan Direct Growth is a Hybrid Mutual Fund Scheme launched by SBI Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 29 Jun 1987. Rama Iyer Srinivasan is the Current Fund Manager of SBI Children's Fund Savings Plan Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹11,46,811 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 20 Apr 2026 is ₹123.55. The SBI Children's Fund Savings Plan Direct Growth is rated Moderately High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹5,000. Exit Load of 3% if redeemed within an year, 2% if redeemed within 2 years and 1% if redeemed within 3 years ...Read more Investment Objective The scheme seeks to provide the investors an opportunity to earn regular income predominantly through investment in debt and money market instruments and capital appreciation through an actively managed equity portfolio.
